manage.title: Manage Trips
manage.emptyHelp: Create your first trip to start tracking travel expenses
manage.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
manage.deleteKeepsTransactions: Its transactions stay; they are only taken off the trip. Its business amounts and reimbursements are deleted.

expenseModeHelp.personal: Everything on this trip is your own spending.
expenseModeHelp.business: Charges you add count as business, to be paid back. You can still mark any of them personal.
expenseModeHelp.mixed: Charges you add start as personal. Mark the business ones, in full or in part.

overview.missingRates_one: {{count}} transaction is left out of these totals because its currency has no exchange rate.
overview.missingRates_other: {{count}} transactions are left out of these totals because their currency has no exchange rate.
overview.empty: No transactions on this trip yet.
overview.spentHelp: Everything charged on this trip, less refunds
overview.businessHelp: To be paid back (denied items not included)
overview.outstandingHelp: Business amount not yet paid back
overview.overReceivedHelp: Reimbursements are above the business amount
overview.netCostHelp: Trip spending less what has been paid back
overview.deniedHelp: Denied business amounts count as personal spending.
overview.receiptsEmpty: No reimbursements recorded yet. Record one when the money arrives, even if it came in your paycheck.

reimburse.deleteKeepsRefund: The deposit it was linked to stays a refund. Change its type on the Transactions page if needed.
reimburse.deleteUnmarks: Items it marked as Reimbursed go back to Submitted.
reimburse.intro: Enter what you actually received. It does not have to match the business amount.
reimburse.depositHelp: The deposit or paycheck the money came in. Leave it empty if you can't tell.
reimburse.noDeposits: No deposits found since the trip started
reimburse.countAsRefund: This deposit is only the reimbursement
reimburse.countAsRefundHelp: Counts the deposit as a refund instead of income, so your dashboard and budgets stop counting the business charges as spending. Leave this off for a paycheck.
reimburse.alreadyRefund: This deposit already counts as a refund.
reimburse.paycheckHelp: A reimbursement inside your paycheck stays part of your income. Your dashboard keeps counting both the charges and the pay, so the difference between them is still right.

transactions.helpBusiness: New charges count as business. Use the split button to keep part of a charge personal.
transactions.helpMixed: Select charges and mark them business, or split one to claim only part of it.
transactions.empty: No transactions on this trip yet

split.title: Business and personal
split.notePlaceholder: e.g. two of the four hotel nights

add.title: Add transactions to {{name}}
add.intro: Charges and refunds around the trip's dates that are not on a trip yet.
add.clearsProject: Adding a transaction to a trip takes it off its project.
add.businessDefault: This is a business trip: added charges count as business.

viewHelp.personal: What the trip cost you, without the business expenses.
viewHelp.business: The business expenses, denied items not included.

insights.nothing: Nothing to show for these filters.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.TRIP_ALLOCATION_NOT_TRIP_EXPENSE: Only a charge on this trip can have a business amount.
errors.TRIP_ALLOCATION_AMOUNT_INVALID: Enter a business amount of 0 or more.
errors.TRIP_DEPOSIT_INVALID: Pick a deposit (money in) for this reimbursement.
